name: Purchase request to ERP
summary: Turns a purchase request into an ERP purchase order. Stock under its minimum is raised as a parked order in Unleashed, a person approves it before it is placed with the supplier, and a receipted order becomes a draft supplier bill in Xero for the owner to match and approve. Crons read and draft; nothing reaches a supplier without approval.

by-hand-or-unstated.evidence: 6 of the 8 calls read describe this way of buying; the variant has no stated turnaround or volume

covered_by.request-raised: reorder (stock under minimum only; other requests by hand)
covered_by.approval: place (queued; a person approves each order before it goes to the supplier)
covered_by.send-po: place (queued; whether Unleashed emails the supplier is unverified)
covered_by.invoice-match: bill (draft bill from the receipted lines; matching is by hand)
covered_by.pay-supplier: not covered (the owner approves the draft bill in Xero)
covered_by.record-keeping: bill (draft bill, so nothing is re-keyed)

crons.name: reorder
crons.summary: Raise a parked purchase order in Unleashed for each product under its minimum with no open order.

crons.name: place
crons.summary: Queue each parked purchase order for a person to place with the supplier.

crons.name: bill
crons.summary: Sync order status from Unleashed and draft the supplier bill in Xero for each receipted order.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a parked purchase order in Unleashed, a supplier contact and a DRAFT bill in Xero, and reads. Moving an order to Placed sends it to the supplier, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

unleashed.covers: stock on hand, products, purchase orders: draft a parked order, and queue placing it (calls not wired until request signing is built)

xero.covers: supplier contacts and draft supplier bills

gaps: Unleashed request signing (HMAC-SHA256) is not built. core/sdk/platforms/unleashed/platform.json has auth type unsupported, so every Unleashed call fails closed until core adds the signer. That is a core change and was not made here.
The Unleashed docs mapped in the kit hold no reorder or minimum stock field. Minimum and order quantities come from settings.reorder_levels, which the business sets.
Reads take the first page only (stock on hand, products, purchase orders). A larger account needs paging added to the adapter.
Budget check: no budget data is mapped for Unleashed or Xero bills, so this step is not covered.
Requests raised by hand are not covered. The reorder cron only sees stock under its minimum.
Send PO: whether Unleashed emails the order to the supplier when it moves to Placed is not confirmed in the mapped docs.
Totals: the draft order sends lines only. Unleashed is assumed to compute the totals (unverified on a live account).
Invoice match: the draft bill carries the purchase order lines, not the supplier's invoice. The owner matches the two by hand.
Pay supplier: no live operation is mapped for approving or paying a bill. The owner approves the draft bill in Xero by hand.
MYOB: its purchase order ops are read only in the kit, and its auth needs a token exchange that is not built. Not adapted.
PrintIQ, Acumatica and Odoo: no mapped API operations in the kit (Odoo maps a version call only; Acumatica has marketing pages and no ops file). Not adapted.
Tested offline only: Unleashed calls are stubbed at the draft boundary, Xero runs through a fake network. Neither is run against a real account.

evidence.calls: The worklist counts 1 call. The variant mining read 8 calls, and 6 describe the process.
evidence.platforms: The platform evidence lists Acumatica and Odoo, with no mapped API operations for either. The adapters use the kit's Unleashed and Xero operations.
